title: Holy Grail
summary: The Holy Grail was a sacred and legendary cup that was sought after by King Arthur who sent the Knights of the Round Table on a quest find it. Three knights succeeded in the quest, Sir Bors, Sir Galahad and Sir Percival while Sir Lancelot was unsuccessful due his falling in love with Guinevere, the wife of King Arthur. [Memory Lane]

The '''Holy Grail''' was a sacred and legendary cup that was sought after by [[King Arthur]] who sent the [[Knights of the Round Table]] on a quest find it. Three knights succeeded in the quest, [[Sir Bors]], [[Sir Galahad]] and [[Sir Percival]] while [[Sir Lancelot]] was unsuccessful due his falling in love with [[Guinevere]], the wife of King Arthur. {{source|Memory Lane}}
